value: Beat-em-up style sidescroller where you play as a variety of gts characters. Characters can grow by eating Alice-in-Wonderland type foods.

You play as Aoi, a highschool girl who is transported to a world of various fairytales after following a mysterious black cat. Travelling through fantasy locations such as Wonderland and Lilliput, she meets new friends with whom she travels to find the source of the corruption which is reeking havoc in the fantasy world.
